methodology.nav: month-end or final partial month; last observation at/before target, at most 7 calendar days old
methodology.trend: fixed cohort over selected window; membership computed from published fund observations
methodology.flows: estimated only; exact continuous chain of valid implied-unit intervals; official issuance/redemption kept separate
methodology.holdings: public partial top positions on differing dates; no NAV-times-weight monetary estimates
methodology.quantity: same ISIN and consecutive monthly official snapshots; corporate actions not verified; not confirmed buying/selling
limitations: Sum of fund NAV may double-count funds holding other funds; not look-through net market assets
No forward fill beyond freshness limit; no zero imputation
Unmatched dates and missing funds excluded; coverage visible
Position value change is not trade flow

statistics.amounts: Raw chart RUB; site table and tooltip thousand RUB (JS divides raw by 1000)
statistics.flows: Provider reported market inflow/outflow series; not individual-security trading
